resources.string: %1$s is installed and may be running in the background, holding the bike\'s link ports (10920–10922), so the dash stays blank. Close it, then reconnect.\n\n\"Close & retry\" tries to stop it for you; if the dash is still blank, use \"App settings\" and tap Force stop.

Something is holding the bike\'s link ports (10920–10922). Close the official app of your bike (Zontes, CFMoto, Carbit Ride…) or any other EasyConnect app: Settings → Apps → Force stop. Then try again.
